meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: The monetary survey (new monetary aggregates NM1, NM2, NM3 and their sources), every month since 1999 (also report 826)
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 544 (data provider DP0), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. One display unit kept (ACTUALS). Amounts in ₹ crore. 52 cells the source prints more than once with different values (2023-07-28, 2023-08-25, 2023-09-22, 2023-10-20 and other dates) are left out: we cannot tell which value is right.
